name: Elephant Trunk Hill (Xiangbishan)
subTitle: Guilin's City Symbol
desc: The iconic hill resembling an elephant drinking from the Li River. A must-see landmark that has represented Guilin for centuries.

attractions.name: Water Moon Cave
attractions.desc: The arch between the 'trunk' and 'body' looks like a full moon floating on water

attractions.name: Elephant Eye Cave
attractions.desc: Cave on the hilltop offering panoramic views of Guilin city

attractions.name: Love Lock Bridge
attractions.desc: Romantic spot with thousands of love locks

tips: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for golden light on the Li River
Combine with a nearby Seven Star Park visit
Take a small boat through Water Moon Cave for a unique perspective

name: Li River Cruise
subTitle: 83km of Living Poetry
desc: The legendary river journey from Guilin to Yangshuo, passing through some of the most breathtaking karst landscapes ever painted or photographed.

attractions.name: 20 Yuan Bill Viewpoint
attractions.desc: The iconic landscape featured on China's 20 yuan banknote

attractions.name: Nine Horses Fresco Hill
attractions.desc: Cliff face that reveals images of horses in its natural patterns

attractions.name: Fishing Cormorants
attractions.desc: Traditional fishing method using trained cormorant birds

tips: Book a star-rated cruise ship for the best experience and English commentary
Sit on the right side for better views during the first half
Arrive at Zhujiang Pier by 8:30 AM for departure

name: Reed Flute Cave (Ludiyan)
subTitle: Underground Wonder Since Tang Dynasty
desc: A spectacular limestone cave with stalactites, stalagmites, and rock formations illuminated by colorful lights. Called the 'Palace of Natural Arts.'

attractions.name: Crystal Palace
attractions.desc: Vast chamber with mirror-like formations reflecting in underground pools

attractions.name: Rainbow Curtain
attractions.desc: Massive flowstone formation lit by multicolored lights

attractions.name: Ancient Inscriptions
attractions.desc: Tang Dynasty calligraphy carved on cave walls over 1,200 years ago

tips: The cave stays cool year-round — bring a light jacket even in summer
Guided tours available in multiple languages including English
Allow about 1 hour for the complete cave tour

name: Yangshuo West Street
subTitle: Where East Meets West
desc: The famous pedestrian street in Yangshuo known for its vibrant nightlife, international cafes, local crafts, and laid-back atmosphere since the 1980s.

attractions.name: International Cafes
attractions.desc: Authentic Western coffee, craft beer, and fusion cuisine

attractions.name: Impression Sanjie Liu
attractions.desc: World-famous outdoor light show on the Li River directed by Zhang Yimou

attractions.name: Yoga & Wellness
attractions.desc: Numerous studios offering classes for travelers

tips: Visit in the evening for the liveliest atmosphere
Try local snacks like beer fish (啤酒鱼) and rice noodles
Many shops accept international currencies

name: Longji Rice Terraces (Dragon's Backbone)
subTitle: Stairway to the Clouds
desc: Spectacular terraced rice fields carved into hillsides by ethnic Zhuang and Yao people over 650 years ago. One of China's most stunning agricultural landscapes.

attractions.name: Seven Stars Around the Moon
attractions.desc: Seven small villages arranged around a central peak

attractions.name: Yao Long-Haired Women
attractions.desc: Meet the Red Yao women famous for their floor-length black hair

attractions.name: Sunset at Ping'an Village
attractions.desc: Golden hour views of terraces reflecting the setting sun

tips: Best seasons: May-June (water-filled terraces) or Sep-Oct (golden harvest)
Stay overnight in a wooden guesthouse for sunrise views
Hiking between villages takes 2-3 hours — wear comfortable shoes

name: Seven Star Park (Qixinggongyuan)
subTitle: Guilin's Largest Scenic Park
desc: The largest comprehensive park in Guilin featuring Seven Star Peak, Camel Hill, Flower Bridge, and the famous Seven Star Cave — all within easy reach of the city center.

attractions.name: Seven Star Cave
attractions.desc: Limestone cave with fascinating formations, a favorite of historical poets

attractions.name: Camel Hill
attractions.desc: Peak shaped exactly like a resting camel

attractions.name: Giant Panda House
attractions.desc: See adorable giant pandas in their Guilin home

tips: Great for families with children — pandas are a highlight
Rent a boat on Crescent Lake inside the park
Combine with nearby Elephant Trunk Hill in one morning

name: Two Rivers & Four Lakes Night Cruise
subTitle: Illuminated Water City Magic
desc: An enchanting evening boat tour through Guilin's inner waterways, passing under beautifully lit ancient bridges and past illuminated pagodas.

attractions.name: Sun and Moon Pagodas
attractions.desc: Twin pagodas on Shanhu Lake — one gold, one silver, lit up magnificently

attractions.name: Banyan Lake
attractions.desc: Scenic lake with ancient banyan trees and traditional pavilions

attractions.name: Wooden Dragon Gate
attractions.desc: Historic gate marking the entrance to the water city area

tips: Book tickets online in advance — popular and often sells out
Choose a window seat for the best photo opportunities
Dress warmly even in summer as it gets breezy on the water

name: Yaoshan Mountain
subTitle: The Roof of Guilin
desc: At 909 meters, Yaoshan is the highest peak in Guilin. Take the cable car or hike to the summit for sweeping panoramic views of the entire karst landscape.

attractions.name: Summit Platform
attractions.desc: 360-degree view of Guilin city, Li River, and surrounding peaks

attractions.name: Yaoshan Tea Plantation
attractions.desc: Sample famous Guilin tea grown on the mountain slopes

attractions.name: Tianzhu Temple
attractions.desc: Ancient Buddhist temple dating back to the Tang Dynasty

tips: Take the cable car up and hike down for the best experience
Early morning visits offer the clearest views and fewer crowds
Bring layers — temperature at the summit can be significantly cooler

name: Yingpan Shangri-La Village
subTitle: Zhuang Culture Immersion
desc: An authentic Zhuang ethnic minority village nestled among rice paddies and karst peaks. Experience traditional architecture, folk customs, and farm-to-table cuisine.

attractions.name: Ancient Drum Tower
attractions.desc: Centuries-old wooden tower used for village gatherings

attractions.name: Zhuang Brocade Workshop
attractions.desc: Watch artisans weave traditional textiles by hand

attractions.name: Farmhouse Dining
attractions.desc: Fresh, organic meals prepared by local families

tips: Arrange transportation through your hotel or a trusted guide
Respect local customs — ask before photographing people
Try the oil tea (油茶), a traditional Zhuang beverage
